title: Experiment Run Trial Reference
description: The configuration run's issued public reference (the stored configuration-run reference: sessions issue trial_ plus 16 hex, an issued reference is never re-minted, unique per tenant, absent until the backend's reference backfill has run). Two issued formats exist: trial_ plus 16 hex (issued by sessions) and configuration_run_ plus 32 hex (minted by the backend). Issued once, never re-minted, so it is stable across views, pages and deletion of other configurations. The internal id is never emitted. A canonical view of a run with any configuration whose reference is not yet issued is the closed 503 until the backfill completes (never a positional or synthetic stand-in). Shared by the report, Pareto and leaderboard views of one experiment run.
